description: Detector emits when stable grasp is established, target object is gripper-dependent, and safe release has NOT begun. VIS attack then targets physical OPEN to induce contact loss, slip, drop, or task failure.

phase_taxonomy.PREGRASP: Before any grasp contact. Gripper open, no target contact.
phase_taxonomy.GRASP_TRANSITION: Gripper closing, contact being established. Not yet stable.
phase_taxonomy.STABLE_GRASP: Target object firmly held. Sustained finger-target contact, gripper closed, object lifted or supported.
phase_taxonomy.TRANSPORT_OR_MANIPULATION: Grasped object being moved, lifted, or manipulated. Object-EEF comotion, support removed.
phase_taxonomy.RELEASE_APPROACH: Approaching placement region. Target progress high but not yet safe.
phase_taxonomy.SAFE_RELEASE: Object placed, gripper opening, placement confirmed. Normal planned release.
phase_taxonomy.POST_RELEASE: After safe release. Object at target, gripper open, task may be complete.
phase_taxonomy.UNKNOWN: Insufficient privileged data to determine phase.

requirements: stable_grasp established (sustained target-finger contact + gripper closed + dwell)
target object is gripper-dependent (lifted or support removed)
K10 feasible (remaining horizon >= 10 AND no safe_release in window)

attack_payload.objective: maximize OPEN token log-mass, minimize CLOSE token log-mass, preserve arm dimensions
forbidden: mixing OPEN and CLOSE mechanisms in same statistic

matched_arms.CLEAN_REPLAY: Clean execution from exact snapshot, no attack
matched_arms.TRUE_VIS_OPEN_T10: VIS-PGD targeting CANONICAL_RAW_OPEN, K=10 burst from emit
matched_arms.RAND_DIRECTION_T10: Same ε/steps/dims but random direction (no gradient), K=10 burst
matched_arms.COMMAND_OPEN_ORACLE_T10: Direct env action gripper=-1 override (physical ground truth for OPEN effect)
matched_arms.RANDOM_TIME_VIS_OPEN_T10: VIS-OPEN payload at pre-registered random anchor, K=10 burst

teacher_heads.physical_criticality: Object is in a gripper-dependent critical phase (STABLE_GRASP or TRANSPORT_OR_MANIPULATION)
teacher_heads.safe_release: Planned normal release confirmed by placement + gripper opening
teacher_heads.instability: Contact loss, slip, unplanned opening, pose anomaly during grasp
teacher_heads.gripper_closing_state: Physical qpos measurement of gripper closure (NOT policy intent)
teacher_heads.k10_feasible: K=10 attack window available without safe_release or terminal in window

scheduler.trigger: p_critical ≥ τ_c AND p_k10 ≥ τ_k AND p_safe < τ_r AND persistence_D
